descriptor.name: ANDF e-Foncier cadastral parcels — Cotonou and Porto-Novo
descriptor.scope: Verified bounded cadastral parcel samples near Cotonou and Porto-Novo. Porto-Novo evidence covers 9 aligned 0.0025-degree cells plus 8 pan cells around the 6.4969 N, 2.6289 E locator. Citywide, commune-wide and national completeness remain unverified; only these configured city entries are proposed.
